contexts: incident reports not flagged for shortages
reading: A substitution changes the product that prescribers, pharmacists and nurses see, and errors can enter at prescribing, preparation or administration. Incident reports capture what staff chose to report; the intervention log captures what pharmacists intercepted; neither alone gives the error rate. No external evidence was retrieved, so the local data must carry the analysis.
